mentions.name: Simple Kubernetes hosting platform
mentions.description: This platform provides users with a simple managed Kubernetes cluster, handling compute, networked storage and ingress hosting with cluster provisioning in minutes. It uses a fixed monthly upfront cost instead of pay-as-you-go pricing to save small developers money, similar to self-hosting with K0S/K3S/OpenShift without owning servers — like serverless K8S. The goal is to undercut the big clouds by saving users' money and time, with Kubernetes serving as the control panel to deploy, run and scale everything.
mentions.problem: Properly setting up Kubernetes on a VPS or big-cloud services (EKS/GKE/LKE/OKE/DOKS) takes a lot of time to configure VPC/EBS/S3/EC2 and requires paying large premiums and overheads, which ordinary users don't want to hassle with; the author is fed up with ludicrous EKS billing.
mentions.audience: Small developers who want to save money and avoid the hassle of setting up and paying for big-cloud Kubernetes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a K8S hosting solution that just gives the user a simple Kubernetes cluster. I (or we) handle the compute, (networked) storage and ingress hosting for you, and the cluster provision time should be within minutes.
